'''''Vanda coerulea''''', commonly known as '''blue orchid''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=VACO7|taxon=Vanda coerulea|access-date=28 July 2015}}</ref> '''blue vanda''' or '''autumn lady's tresses''', is a species of [[orchid]] found in  [[Northeast India]] with its range extending to [[China]] (southern [[Yunnan]]). It is known as ''kwaklei'' in [[Meitei language|Manipuri]] and ''vandaar'' in [[Sanskrit]].{{Citation needed|date=November 2025}} It has bluish purple flowers which are very long-lasting compared to other orchids. The plant bears up to 20 to 30 spikes.

== Taxonomy ==
The plant was first formally first described by [[John Lindley]] in 1847 from the description provided by [[William Griffith (botanist)|William Griffith]]. The latter had obtained the specimen from the [[Khasi Hills]], and named it. He then sent the dried specimens to London.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Lindley |first=John |date=1847 |title=Vanda violacea |url=https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/item/9070#page/86/mode/1up |journal=Edward's Botanical Register |volume=33 |pages=30 |via=Biodiversity Heritage Library}}</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
Previously, it was thought to have been found only in the Khasi Hills.<ref name=":0" /> Here it seemed was threatened as it was over-collected due to its ornamental nature, and local charcoal production from oak trees on which they usually grow. Therefore it was placed in the [[CITES Appendix I]] in the 1970s.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Vanda coerulea Griff. ex Lindl. {{!}} General Information |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:660987-1 |access-date=2025-11-23 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref>

== Medicinal uses ==
The flower's juice is used as eye drops against [[glaucoma]], cataract and blindness.<ref>Mohammad Musharof Hossain "Therapeutic orchids: traditional uses and recent advances — An overview",  ⁎ Department of Botany, University of Chittagong, Chittagong 4331, Bangladesh</ref> Active ingredients of ''Vanda coerulea'' may fight against the visible signs of ageing skin.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Bonté |first=F. |last2=Simmler |first2=C. |last3=Lobstein |first3=A. |last4=Pellicier |first4=F. |last5=Cauchard |first5=J.-H. |date=2011 |title=Action d’un extrait de Vanda coerulea sur la sénescence de fibroblastes cutanés |trans-title=Action of an extract of Vanda coerulea on the senescence of skin fibroblasts |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0003450911000289 |journal=Annales Pharmaceutiques Françaises |language=fr |volume=69 |issue=3 |pages=177–181 |doi=10.1016/j.pharma.2011.02.001|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
